prompt_suffix.car_standalone_1px: In this image the scan has been redrawn as a grid of car emoji on a white background, one car per pixel of the scan. The more opaque (darker red) a car, the stronger the element signal at that pixel; faint or invisible cars are background. A particle is a cluster of neighbouring opaque cars: draw ONE box around each cluster, not around each car.
